overview: A Right of First Offer (ROFO) in a lease is a clause requiring a landlord to offer a space or property to an existing tenant before marketing it to third parties. The tenant gets the first chance to make an offer, allowing for faster negotiations and potential expansion, but the landlord can reject it and seek better terms elsewhere.
